title_ru: СКАФАНДР — СКАФАНДРЫ И ВЫХОДЫ В ОТКРЫТЫЙ КОСМОС
description: An interactive field guide to spacesuits: why a suit is a personal spacecraft inflated to about the pressure of a basketball, the trade between low pressure (mobility) and high pressure (no decompression sickness), NASA's tissue-ratio rule R ≤ 1.65 with a 360-minute nitrogen compartment, and how oxygen prebreathe, the Shuttle staged protocol and the ISS campout wash nitrogen out before a spacewalk.
og: 4.3 psi of pure oxygen, R ≤ 1.65 and hours of prebreathe: how a spacewalk avoids the bends, interactive and checked against NASA's protocols.
brand: SUIT — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
